    # Draw the pattern encoded along the bottom row, aligning each isolated
    # marker with its matching color in that pattern.
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    key = [v for v in g[-1] if v != 0]
    keyrow = h - 1
    markers = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h - 1) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] != 0]
    for r, c, color in markers:
        if color not in key:
            continue
        k = key.index(color)
        start = c - k
        for j, v in enumerate(key):
            x = start + j
            if 0 <= x < w:
                g[r][x] = v
    return g
